description: The full build prompt for one component. Needs the access key of a paid Vibesignet plan (Monthly, Yearly or Founders), sent as the Authorization header or as access_key. Components have their own allowance (15 new in any 30 days on Monthly) and never use a template unlock; fetching one again is free.

access_key.description: The user's access key (starts with vs_), if it was not set on the connection.

id.description: The component id from search_components, for example "ripple".

name: get_component_prompt
title: Get a component prompt
